## Invariants
1. Eval execution is deterministic: same feature-status input produces byte-identical JSONL output.
2. No LLM in runtime eval loop; scoring is purely rule-based.
3. Reward values are normalized to [-1.0, 1.0] per eval item.
4. Eval results are advisory and must not auto-mutate feature status.
